title: 第十五章 管家伯顿的两个儿子第十六章 王国贵族神秘骨笛
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: 另一边的霍格在边上一直看着，他没想到这么短时间里，对面这个李奥的实力竟然变得这么强了。
他感觉亚瑟全程都没占到什么优势，反而被李奥一直压着打。
就连他都看出来到了后半程，李奥基本上已经在逗亚瑟玩了。
他曾经看过克拉森教官手底下的那些侍童练剑。
那边最厉害的是一个叫做罗格的，可是刚刚李奥展现出的剑术，好像不比那个罗格要弱。
可李奥和他一样，才成为侍童一个月。
看着李奥，霍格心中也燃起了一团火焰。
要知道，原先四个侍童里面，李奥天赋最差，然后便是他。
既然李奥能在这么短时间里进步这么多，那么他是不是也可以。
一切才刚刚开始。
他今天才在克拉森手下上了第一节基础剑术课，此时的他心中似有了目标。
一批进来的三名侍童此时在这个不大的剑室里，各自有着自己的想法，但好像都找到了自己的方向。
然而此时，马厩的角落中。
四个侍童中唯一没有通过马术考核的艾迪，正面对着管家伯顿双膝跪地。
偌大的马厩大门紧闭，只有伯顿和艾迪两人，还有马栏里的八匹马。
“真是一个废物。就你这样的，还想争夺黄金骑士团的推荐名额，继续在这喂马铲屎吧！”
“对不起父亲。”艾迪低垂着头，拳头咯咯作响。
啪！
一个清脆的巴掌直接扇在了艾迪的脸上，“我说过多少次，不要叫我父亲，就算是这里没有人也不行！”
艾迪低着脑袋，紧闭着嘴唇，他感觉脸上火辣辣的，面皮隐隐抽动。
其实养马骑马的知识他早就会，他在刚来黑石城的时候便私下试过。
那时候还很顺利，骑马、喂马、护理，当时这些马都算听话。
可不知道为什么今天，他连最基本的上马都办不到。
一共六匹马，每匹都跟他有仇似的。
作为伯顿秘密的私生子，他从小被寄养在麦穗城男爵那里，基础的剑术和马术他早已十分纯熟。
伯顿和麦穗城男爵做了笔交易，让他这个私生子顶着男爵之子的身份到黑石城学习。
佐罗是伯顿和发妻所生的大儿子，由于出生原因，他永远只能停留在骑士侍从这一层。
而且这已经算是拉福林念及主仆之情。
但他的这个私生子艾迪，却可以走到更高的位置。
甚至由于生母的原因，伯顿喜欢艾迪胜过佐罗。
所以他花了那么多心思，让艾迪成为骑士侍童，为的就是让他能够成为一名真正的骑士。
甚至加入黄金骑士团，真正走到另一个崭新的阶层，贵族阶层。
所以，他让艾迪跟着伯爵儿子亚瑟的身边，为了将来的人脉打基础。
可不曾想，现在两人已经闹掰。
这次马术考核，就连那个傻乎乎的霍格都完成了考核动作。
而这个艾迪却在大庭广众之下像个傻子一般，让他出了丑。
伯顿压抑着怒火。
“我知道了，一定是那个叫李奥的乡巴佬搞的鬼！”艾迪突然抬起了头，又看了看另一边一脸无辜的马儿，“肯定是他，明明之前都好好的，后来他天天在这马厩里和这些马眉来眼去，这些马肯定是被他教坏了。”
又是一声清脆的巴掌声响起。
content_en:
Hogg on the other side kept watching. He didn't expect that Leo on the other side would become so powerful in such a short period of time.
He felt that Arthur did not have any advantage throughout the whole process, but was kept suppressed and beaten by Leo.
Even he could tell that by the second half, Leo was basically teasing Arthur.
He once watched the servants under Instructor Clason practice sword practice.
The most powerful one there is a man named Rogge, but the swordsmanship Leo showed just now seems to be no weaker than that Rogge.
But Leo, like him, had only been a page boy for a month.
Looking at Leo, a fire ignited in Hogg's heart.
You know, among the original four waiters, Leo was the least talented, and then he was the one with the worst talent.
Since Leo can improve so much in such a short period of time, can he do the same?
Everything has just begun.
He just had his first basic swordsmanship lesson under Clason today, and at this time he seemed to have a goal in mind.
A group of three servants who came in were now in this small sword room. Each had their own ideas, but they all seemed to have found their own direction.
…
However, at this time, in the corner of the stable.
Eddie, the only one among the four waiters who failed the equestrian test, knelt down facing the butler Burton.
The door of the huge stable was closed, and there were only Burton and Eddie, as well as eight horses in the stalls.
"What a waste. You're like you, and you still want to compete for a recommendation spot in the Golden Knights. Just continue to feed horses and shovel shit here!"
"I'm sorry, father." Eddie lowered his head and cracked his fists.
Snap!
A crisp slap hit Eddie's face directly, "How many times have I told you not to call me father, even if there is no one here!"
Eddie lowered his head and closed his lips tightly. He felt his face was burning and his face was twitching faintly.
In fact, he already knew the knowledge of horse breeding and riding. He had tried it in private when he first came to Black Rock City.
It was going very well at that time, riding, feeding and caring for the horses, and the horses were considered obedient at that time.
But he didn't know why today, he couldn't even do the most basic thing of mounting a horse.
There were six horses in total, and each one seemed to have a grudge against him.
As the secret illegitimate son of Burton, he was fostered by the Baron of Wheatear City since he was a child. He was already very proficient in basic swordsmanship and equestrian skills.
Burton made a deal with the Baron of Wheatspike City, allowing his illegitimate son to study in Blackstone City as the baron's son.
Zorro is the eldest son born to Burton and his first wife. Due to his birth, he can only stay at the level of knight squire.
And this can be regarded as the love between Laflin and his master and servant.
But his illegitimate son Eddie can reach a higher position.
Even because of his biological mother, Burton prefers Eddie to Zorro.
So he put so much thought into making Eddie a knight's page, so that he could become a real knight.
He even joined the Golden Knights and truly reached another new class, the aristocratic class.
Therefore, he asked Eddie to stay with the Earl's son Arthur to lay the foundation for future connections.
But I never thought that the two of them had broken up now.
In this equestrian assessment, even the silly Hogg completed the assessment.
But this Eddie acted like a fool in public, making him embarrassed.
Burton suppressed his anger.
"I know, it must be that country bumpkin named Leo who is responsible!" Eddie suddenly raised his head and looked at the innocent-looking horses on the other side. "It must be him. He was obviously good before, but then he flirted with these horses in this stable every day. These horses must have been taught bad things by him."
"Crack!"
Another crisp slap sounded.
